name: OmaGravity
author: Carl Kaufman
description: Antigravity CLI integration for Omarchy. Fast launcher, Herdr workspace routing, interactive session manager, and Quickshell bar panel.

barWidget.description: Antigravity CLI launcher, session switcher, and agent manager.

schema.label: Show on Top Bar
schema.description: Display the OmaGravity status icon directly on the top bar.

schema.label: Launch Mode
schema.description: Target environment when launching Antigravity sessions.

schema.label: Preferred Terminal
schema.description: Terminal emulator to spawn when launchMode is terminal or floating.

schema.label: Default Working Directory
schema.description: Initial working directory when starting a new session.

schema.label: Auto-Approve Tool Permissions
schema.description: Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions to agy on quick launch.

schema.label: Recent Sessions Count
schema.description: Maximum number of recent conversations to display in session explorer.

schema.label: State Refresh Interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the background status poller syncs conversation state.
